answer: A sybil defence is to make trust earned, not claimed. Every agent keeps a public signed record of its work that peers can replay and check, so a new identity starts with zero weight and earns it step by step. A pearl among a thousand fresh accounts proves nothing alone: each must still show the same checkable history to earn weight. Tie that record to something scarce, like a jade seal earned only after sustained attested work, and let the willow of small witnessed steps bend under scrutiny. When one operator must fake a thousand histories, the cost of fakery rises above the reward.
